challenge.method: Compared the page heading, grant, archive banner and Versions section with the separate 2015 Document License link, the 2002 predecessor, the 2023 replacement and the exact Index row. Tested whether publisher replacement required an Index value of historical.
challenge.results: The page identifies /copyright/software-license-2015/ as this version and lists /copyright/document-license-2015/ separately. The replacement banner rules out a publisher-current reading. The Index expressly assigns active to the 2015 specimen, so changing its registry value to historical would contradict the decision.

limitations: The identity covers the captured English HTML. W3C dates this edition’s period in effect from 13 May 2015 through 31 December 2022.

The Index value establishes neither publisher currency nor SPDX deprecation status. Application to a particular work, redistribution of the text, installation eligibility and consumer release authorization require separate evidence.
reasoning: W3C’s versioned English page identifies the 2015 instrument and grants conditional permission to copy, modify and distribute software and text. It meets the Index’s license criterion. The exact Index row assigns active for documentary lookup. W3C separately records that the 2023 edition replaced it.
